test_concat_axis_parameter: test the concat function with axis parameter for stacking DataFrames and Series along rows or columns
test_concat_multiple_frames_dtypes: test concatenating DataFrames with different dtypes preserves column dtypes when concatenating along axis 1
test_concat_named_keys: test concat with named keys and MultiIndex level names for labeled concatenation of DataFrames
test_concat_tuple_keys: test concat with tuple keys to create nested MultiIndex from concatenated DataFrames
test_outer_sort_columns: test concat with join outer and sort True to sort columns alphabetically in the result DataFrame
